skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator, including zero or improper numerator cases.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and convert fractional parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Separate and combine mixed-number parts
skills.definition: For whole numbers or mixed numbers, separate whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts using implicit zero parts when needed, and recombine the final result while omitting zero parts.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms by canceling common factors.
